cases.input: A measured N+1 query dominates a 50k-row import. Produce a concept and TASK.md that a coding agent can execute.
requiredBehaviors: define a measurable performance gate and functional gate
split implementation into verifiable slices and document rejected alternatives
forbiddenBehaviors: hide irreversible design decisions as assumptions

cases.input: Two candidates offer similar benefit: a local batching change and a new distributed cache with higher operational risk.
requiredBehaviors: prefer the smaller lower-risk candidate when it plausibly meets the budget
document the cache alternative and rejection reason
forbiddenBehaviors: introduce new infrastructure solely because it may be faster

cases.input: Create TASK.md from code style observations only; no baseline, hotspot map, or target exists.
requiredBehaviors: refuse to present an evidence-free performance plan as implementation-ready
route back to measurement and hotspot analysis
